# Treatment Effect on Productivity of Hired (The Efficiency Myth) {#sec-efficiency}

## Does Blinding Lead to More Accurate Coding Skill Evaluations?

\textbf{Takeaway:} Removing demographic information (or noise) does \emph{not} meaningfully improve evaluators' ability to identify top-ability candidates --- signal extraction remains flat.

\textcolor{blue}{\textbf{Specification}}:
\vspace{-0.7em}
$$
\text{Hiring Evaluation Score (Z)} \sim \text{True Coding Ability (Z)} \times \mathbbm{1}[\text{Blind arm}] \mid \text{Respondent FE} + \text{Display Position FE}.
$$
\vspace{-1.4em}
\begin{itemize}\setlength\itemsep{0pt}\setlength\parskip{0pt}\setlength\topsep{0pt}\setlength\partopsep{0pt}
    \item $H_0\!: \beta = 0$ --- the evaluator extracts \emph{no signal} from true coding ability.
    \item $H_0\!: \beta = 1$ --- the evaluator is \emph{perfectly calibrated}: a $1$ SD rise in true ability produces exactly a $1$ SD rise in the rating, with no shrinkage.
\end{itemize}

```{r blind_hiring_signal_extraction, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis', warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
## Pooled z-score of the lab coding score (constant within resume_index)
firm_long_dt[, true_coding_z := (overall_score - mean(overall_score, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                                  sd(overall_score, na.rm = TRUE)]

## Two pooled interacted regressions --- one per role. Since treat is
## between-respondent, responseid FE absorbs the main effect of treat but
## leaves both the main slope on true_coding_z (identified from within-
## respondent variation, by definition the nonblind arm's slope since
## nonblind is the reference) and the interaction slope identifiable.
m_hr  <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
  feols(sc_coding_z ~ true_coding_z * i(treat, ref = "nonblind")
        | responseid + r_do,
        data = firm_long_dt[role == "HR"],
        vcov = ~ responseid)
))
m_eng <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
  feols(sc_coding_z ~ true_coding_z * i(treat, ref = "nonblind")
        | responseid + r_do,
        data = firm_long_dt[role == "Eng"],
        vcov = ~ responseid)
))

## Extract arm-specific slopes, SEs, and the four tests (H0: beta = 0 / 1
## for each arm) from a single pooled model. beta_nonblind = main coef;
## beta_blind = main + interaction; SE(beta_blind) via linear-combination
## formula using the full vcov matrix.
extract_stats <- function(m) {
  ct    <- coeftable(m)
  V     <- vcov(m)
  main_name <- "true_coding_z"
  int_name  <- "true_coding_z:treat::blind"

  b_main <- ct[main_name, "Estimate"]
  s_main <- ct[main_name, "Std. Error"]
  b_int  <- ct[int_name,  "Estimate"]
  s_int  <- ct[int_name,  "Std. Error"]
  cov_mi <- V[main_name, int_name]

  b_nb <- b_main
  s_nb <- s_main
  b_b  <- b_main + b_int
  s_b  <- sqrt(s_main^2 + s_int^2 + 2 * cov_mi)

  pval <- function(t) 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(t)))
  p_nb_0 <- pval(b_nb / s_nb)
  p_nb_1 <- pval((b_nb - 1) / s_nb)
  p_b_0  <- pval(b_b  / s_b)
  p_b_1  <- pval((b_b  - 1) / s_b)
  ## H0: beta_blind = beta_nonblind is the same as H0: beta_interaction = 0,
  ## so we read its p-value directly off the interaction coefficient.
  p_eq   <- ct[int_name, 4]

  fs <- fitstat(m, c("r2", "ar2"), simplify = TRUE)
  list(b_nb = unname(b_nb), s_nb = unname(s_nb),
       b_b  = unname(b_b),  s_b  = unname(s_b),
       p_nb_0 = p_nb_0, p_nb_1 = p_nb_1,
       p_b_0  = p_b_0,  p_b_1  = p_b_1,
       p_eq   = unname(p_eq),
       n = m$nobs, r2 = unname(fs["r2"]), ar2 = unname(fs["ar2"]))
}

s_hr  <- extract_stats(m_hr)
s_eng <- extract_stats(m_eng)

## Formatting helpers.
sig_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p))        ""
  else if (p < 0.01)   "***"
  else if (p < 0.05)   "**"
  else if (p < 0.10)   "*"
  else                 ""
}
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  pstr <- if (p < 0.001) "$<\\!0.001$" else sprintf("%.3f", p)
  paste0("p = ", pstr, sig_stars(p))
}

chk <- "\\checkmark"
nox <- "$\\times$"

cell_col <- function(s) c(
  sprintf("%.3f~(%.3f)", s$b_nb, s$s_nb),
  sprintf("%.3f~(%.3f)", s$b_b,  s$s_b),
  format(s$n,   big.mark = ","),
  sprintf("%.3f", s$r2),
  sprintf("%.3f", s$ar2),
  nox, chk, chk, nox
)

tbl <- data.frame(
  lbl = c("$\\hat\\beta_{\\text{nonblind}}$ (slope, nonblind arm)",
          "$\\hat\\beta_{\\text{blind}}$ (slope, blind arm)",
          "Observations",
          "$R^2$",
          "Adj. $R^2$",
          "Resume (Content) FE",
          "Display Position FE",
          "Respondent FE",
          "Respondent Characteristics"),
  HR  = cell_col(s_hr),
  Eng = cell_col(s_eng),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(tbl) <- c(" ", "HR", "Engineer")

## Build the plot and save it to disk so we can include it via
## \includegraphics inside a LaTeX minipage layout.
plot_data <- data.frame(
  role = factor(c("HR", "HR", "Engineer", "Engineer"),
                levels = c("HR", "Engineer")),
  arm  = factor(c("Nonblind", "Blind", "Nonblind", "Blind"),
                levels = c("Nonblind", "Blind")),
  est  = c(s_hr$b_nb,  s_hr$b_b,  s_eng$b_nb, s_eng$b_b),
  se   = c(s_hr$s_nb,  s_hr$s_b,  s_eng$s_nb, s_eng$s_b)
)
plot_data$ci_lo <- plot_data$est - 1.96 * plot_data$se
plot_data$ci_hi <- plot_data$est + 1.96 * plot_data$se

p_signal <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = est, y = arm, color = arm)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ role, ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Nonblind" = "#d62728", "Blind" = "#1f77b4")) +
  labs(x = expression(hat(beta)*": slope of evaluator rating on true coding ability"),
       y = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"))

## Save plot to disk so we can include it via \includegraphics inside a
## LaTeX minipage (table on left, plot on right).
fig_dir <- here("2_Reports", "figures")
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
plot_file <- file.path(fig_dir, "8B_signal_extraction.pdf")
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
  ggsave(plot_file, plot = p_signal, width = 4.5, height = 2.6, device = "pdf")
))

cat("\\begin{table}[H]\n")
cat("\\centering\n")
cat("\\begin{minipage}[c]{0.50\\textwidth}\n")
cat("\\centering\n")
cat("{\\fontsize{7}{9}\\selectfont\n")

## Plain kable + row_spec (no kable_styling, since kable_styling adds an
## inner \\begin{table} wrapper that LaTeX rejects inside a minipage).
print(
  kable(tbl, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
        align = "lcc", row.names = FALSE) %>%
    row_spec(2, extra_latex_after = "\\midrule") %>%
    row_spec(5, extra_latex_after = "\\midrule")
)

cat("}\n")
cat("\\end{minipage}%\n")
cat("\\begin{minipage}[c]{0.48\\textwidth}\n")
cat("\\centering\n")
cat("\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth]{", plot_file, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\end{minipage}\n")

cat("\\par\\vspace{0.4em}\n")
cat("\\noindent\\begin{minipage}{0.98\\textwidth}\\scriptsize\n")
cat("Cluster-robust standard errors (by respondent) shown in parentheses next to each $\\hat\\beta$.\\\\\n")
cat("Stars on p-values: * $p<0.10$, ** $p<0.05$, *** $p<0.01$.\n")
cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
cat("\\end{table}\n\n")

rm(m_hr, m_eng, s_hr, s_eng,
   extract_stats, sig_stars, fmt_p, cell_col,
   chk, nox, tbl, plot_data, p_signal, plot_file, fig_dir)
```

```{r prod_het_table_helper, echo=FALSE}
## Vectorised cell formatter for the per-k underlying-data tables in
## sections 4.2-4.6: prints "estimate*** (se)" with two-sided z-test
## stars (* p<.10, ** p<.05, *** p<.01). NA inputs render as "---".
## Defined in its own chunk so it survives the per-section rm() calls.
fmt_te_vec <- function(est, se) {
  out <- rep("---", length(est))
  ok  <- !is.na(est) & !is.na(se) & se > 0
  if (any(ok)) {
    z    <- est[ok] / se[ok]
    p    <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
    star <- ifelse(p < 0.01, "***",
            ifelse(p < 0.05, "**",
            ifelse(p < 0.10, "*", "")))
    out[ok] <- sprintf("%.3f%s (%.3f)", est[ok], star, se[ok])
  }
  out
}
```

## Does Blinding Lead to Selection of More Productive Coders?

\textbf{Takeaway:} Blind hiring has a \emph{null} effect on the actual coding quality of the hired cohort.

```{r blind_hiring_coding_quality, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# ==============================================================================
# HELPER: Dynamic standardization relative to nonblind group at each k
# ==============================================================================
get_avg_coding_score <- function(role_filter, treat_filter, k, 
                                  pass_var_prefix, data) {
  col <- paste0(pass_var_prefix, k)
  d   <- data[role == role_filter & treat == treat_filter & get(col) == 1]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(d$overall_score, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ==============================================================================
# COMPUTE TREATMENT EFFECT AT EACH K
# ==============================================================================
results_list <- list()

for (k in 1:18) {

  # --- HR ---
  hr_col  <- paste0("hr_pass", k)
  hr_data <- firm_long_dt[role == "HR" & get(hr_col) > 0]

  # Dynamic standardization: relative to nonblind mean/sd at this k
  ctrl_mean_hr <- hr_data[treat == "nonblind", .wmean(overall_score, get(hr_col))]
  ctrl_sd_hr   <- hr_data[treat == "nonblind", .wsd(overall_score, get(hr_col))]

  if (!is.na(ctrl_sd_hr) && ctrl_sd_hr > 0) {
    hr_data[, overall_score_std := (overall_score - ctrl_mean_hr) / ctrl_sd_hr]

    tryCatch({
      m_hr <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
        feols(overall_score_std ~ i(treat, ref = "nonblind") + resp_age |
                q_version + resp_gender + resp_race + s2_educ + s2_income,
              data = hr_data, weights = as.formula(paste0('~', hr_col)), vcov = ~ responseid)
      ))
      ct <- coeftable(m_hr)
      if ("treat::blind" %in% rownames(ct)) {
        est   <- ct["treat::blind", "Estimate"]
        se    <- ct["treat::blind", "Std. Error"]
        p_val <- ct["treat::blind", 4]
        results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.table(
          Stage = "HR Stage", k = k,
          estimate = est,
          ci_low   = est - 1.96 * se,
          ci_high  = est + 1.96 * se,
          p_val    = p_val
        )
      }
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }

  # --- Engineer ---
  eng_col  <- paste0("eng_top", k)
  eng_data <- firm_long_dt[role == "Eng" & get(eng_col) > 0]

  ctrl_mean_eng <- eng_data[treat == "nonblind", .wmean(overall_score, get(eng_col))]
  ctrl_sd_eng   <- eng_data[treat == "nonblind", .wsd(overall_score, get(eng_col))]

  if (!is.na(ctrl_sd_eng) && ctrl_sd_eng > 0) {
    eng_data[, overall_score_std := (overall_score - ctrl_mean_eng) / ctrl_sd_eng]

    tryCatch({
      m_eng <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
        feols(overall_score_std ~ i(treat, ref = "nonblind") + resp_age |
                q_version + resp_gender + resp_race + s2_educ + s2_income +
                resp_python + resp_java,
              data = eng_data, weights = as.formula(paste0('~', eng_col)), vcov = ~ responseid)
      ))
      ct <- coeftable(m_eng)
      if ("treat::blind" %in% rownames(ct)) {
        est   <- ct["treat::blind", "Estimate"]
        se    <- ct["treat::blind", "Std. Error"]
        p_val <- ct["treat::blind", 4]
        results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.table(
          Stage = "Engineer Stage", k = k,
          estimate = est,
          ci_low   = est - 1.96 * se,
          ci_high  = est + 1.96 * se,
          p_val    = p_val
        )
      }
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }
}

dt_plot <- rbindlist(results_list)
dt_plot[, Stage := factor(Stage, levels = c("HR Stage", "Engineer Stage"))]
dt_plot[, sig_stars := fcase(
  p_val < 0.01, "***",
  p_val < 0.05, "**",
  p_val < 0.10, "*",
  default = ""
)]

# ==============================================================================
# PLOT
# ==============================================================================
p_obj <- ggplot(dt_plot, aes(x = k, y = estimate, color = Stage)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
                  linewidth = 0.8, size = 0.6, fatten = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(y = ci_high, label = sig_stars),

  facet_wrap(~ Stage, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("HR Stage" = "#C44E52", "Engineer Stage" = "#4C72B0")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:18, name = "Number of Candidates Selected (k)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.3, 0.3)) +
  labs(
    subtitle = paste("Treatment effect on true productivity measure (coding lab evaluation)",
                     "of selected candidates, standardized relative to selected candidates",
                     "under no blinding at each k"),
    y       = "Effect on Actual Coding Score (SD, relative to nonblind)",
    caption = "Positive = blind hiring selects candidates with higher actual coding scores.\nSignificance: * p<0.10, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray30"),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
    plot.caption       = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
  )
print(p_obj)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Underlying per-k estimate table that drives the plot above.
## Cells: estimate*** (clustered SE). Rows = k; columns = HR vs Engineer.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
dt_plot[, se   := (ci_high - estimate) / 1.96]
dt_plot[, cell := fmt_te_vec(estimate, se)]
tbl <- dcast(dt_plot, k ~ Stage, value.var = "cell")
setnames(tbl, "k", "$k$")

rm(results_list, dt_plot, tbl, p_obj, k,
   hr_col, hr_data, ctrl_mean_hr, ctrl_sd_hr, m_hr, ct,
   eng_col, eng_data, ctrl_mean_eng, ctrl_sd_eng, m_eng,
   est, se, p_val)
```

### Decomposition of Treatment Effect on Productivity

```{r blind_hiring_coding_quality_components, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}

components     <- c("test_case", "readability", "time_efficiency", "space_efficiency", "runtime")
component_lbls <- c(test_case        = "Test Cases",
                    readability      = "Readability",
                    time_efficiency  = "Time Efficiency",
                    space_efficiency = "Space Efficiency",
                    runtime          = "Runtime")

results_list <- list()

for (cmp in components) {
  for (k in 1:18) {

    ## --- HR ---
    hr_col  <- paste0("hr_pass", k)
    hr_data <- firm_long_dt[role == "HR" & get(hr_col) > 0 & !is.na(get(cmp))]
    ctrl_mean_hr <- hr_data[treat == "nonblind", .wmean(get(cmp), get(hr_col))]
    ctrl_sd_hr   <- hr_data[treat == "nonblind", .wsd(get(cmp), get(hr_col))]
    if (!is.na(ctrl_sd_hr) && ctrl_sd_hr > 0) {
      hr_data[, std_outcome := (get(cmp) - ctrl_mean_hr) / ctrl_sd_hr]
      tryCatch({
        m_hr <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
          feols(std_outcome ~ i(treat, ref = "nonblind") + resp_age |
                  q_version + resp_gender + resp_race + s2_educ + s2_income,
                data = hr_data, weights = as.formula(paste0('~', hr_col)), vcov = ~ responseid)
        ))
        ct <- coeftable(m_hr)
        if ("treat::blind" %in% rownames(ct)) {
          est <- ct["treat::blind", "Estimate"]; se <- ct["treat::blind", "Std. Error"]; p_val <- ct["treat::blind", 4]
          results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <- data.table(
            component = component_lbls[cmp], Stage = "HR Stage", k = k,
            estimate = est, se = se,
            ci_low = est - 1.96 * se, ci_high = est + 1.96 * se, p_val = p_val
          )
        }
      }, error = function(e) {})
    }

    ## --- Engineer ---
    eng_col  <- paste0("eng_top", k)
    eng_data <- firm_long_dt[role == "Eng" & get(eng_col) > 0 & !is.na(get(cmp))]
    ctrl_mean_eng <- eng_data[treat == "nonblind", .wmean(get(cmp), get(eng_col))]
    ctrl_sd_eng   <- eng_data[treat == "nonblind", .wsd(get(cmp), get(eng_col))]
    if (!is.na(ctrl_sd_eng) && ctrl_sd_eng > 0) {
      eng_data[, std_outcome := (get(cmp) - ctrl_mean_eng) / ctrl_sd_eng]
      tryCatch({
        m_eng <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
          feols(std_outcome ~ i(treat, ref = "nonblind") + resp_age |
                  q_version + resp_gender + resp_race + s2_educ + s2_income +
                  resp_python + resp_java,
                data = eng_data, weights = as.formula(paste0('~', eng_col)), vcov = ~ responseid)
        ))
        ct <- coeftable(m_eng)
        if ("treat::blind" %in% rownames(ct)) {
          est <- ct["treat::blind", "Estimate"]; se <- ct["treat::blind", "Std. Error"]; p_val <- ct["treat::blind", 4]
          results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <- data.table(
            component = component_lbls[cmp], Stage = "Engineer Stage", k = k,
            estimate = est, se = se,
            ci_low = est - 1.96 * se, ci_high = est + 1.96 * se, p_val = p_val
          )
        }
      }, error = function(e) {})
    }
  }
}

dt_plot <- rbindlist(results_list)
dt_plot[, Stage     := factor(Stage,     levels = c("HR Stage", "Engineer Stage"))]
dt_plot[, component := factor(component, levels = unname(component_lbls))]
dt_plot[, sig_stars := fcase(p_val < 0.01, "***", p_val < 0.05, "**", p_val < 0.10, "*", default = "")]

p_obj <- ggplot(dt_plot, aes(x = k, y = estimate, color = Stage)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
                  linewidth = 0.5, size = 0.4, fatten = 3) +
  ## Clamp the star's y-position to stay inside the y-axis cap so the star
  ## remains visible even when ci_high overshoots ±0.6.
  geom_text(aes(y = pmin(pmax(ci_high, -0.55), 0.55), label = sig_stars),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(component ~ Stage) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("HR Stage" = "#C44E52", "Engineer Stage" = "#4C72B0"),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:18, name = "Number of Candidates Selected (k)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.6, 0.6)) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "Per-component decomposition of TE on selected candidate quality (each component standardized per k relative to nonblind)",
    y       = "Effect on Component Score (SD, relative to nonblind)",
    caption = "Visibility: engineers see test_case directly; HR sees none. Readability / time / space are unobserved by both sides (latent lab measurements).\nSignificance: * p<0.10, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01."
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray30"),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.caption       = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
  )
print(p_obj)

## Underlying per-k coefficient table.
dt_plot[, cell := fmt_te_vec(estimate, se)]
tbl <- dcast(dt_plot, k ~ component + Stage, value.var = "cell")
col_order <- c("k", as.vector(outer(c("HR Stage", "Engineer Stage"), unname(component_lbls),
                                     function(s, c) paste(c, s, sep = "_"))))
col_order <- intersect(col_order, names(tbl))
setcolorder(tbl, col_order)
disp <- c("$k$", rep(c("HR", "Eng"), times = length(components)))
setnames(tbl, col_order, disp[seq_along(col_order)])

rm(results_list, dt_plot, tbl, p_obj, components, component_lbls, col_order, disp,
   cmp, k, hr_col, hr_data, ctrl_mean_hr, ctrl_sd_hr, m_hr, ct,
   eng_col, eng_data, ctrl_mean_eng, ctrl_sd_eng, m_eng,
   est, se, p_val)
```

## Does Blinding's Productivity Effect Differ by Evaluator's DEI Orientation?

```{r blind_hiring_coding_quality_by_dei, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, out.width="0.95\\textwidth", fig.align="center"}

results_list <- list()
dei_pts <- c(-1, 0, 1)
dei_lbl <- c("Low DEI (-1 SD)", "Mid DEI (0)", "High DEI (+1 SD)")

for (k in 1:18) {

  ## --- HR ---
  hr_col  <- paste0("hr_pass", k)
  hr_data <- firm_long_dt[role == "HR" & get(hr_col) > 0]
  ctrl_mean_hr <- hr_data[treat == "nonblind", .wmean(overall_score, get(hr_col))]
  ctrl_sd_hr   <- hr_data[treat == "nonblind", .wsd(overall_score, get(hr_col))]

  if (!is.na(ctrl_sd_hr) && ctrl_sd_hr > 0) {
    hr_data[, overall_score_std := (overall_score - ctrl_mean_hr) / ctrl_sd_hr]

    tryCatch({
      m_hr <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
        feols(overall_score_std ~ i(treat, ref = "nonblind") * dei_index_z + resp_age |
                q_version + resp_gender + resp_race + s2_educ + s2_income,
              data = hr_data, weights = as.formula(paste0('~', hr_col)), vcov = ~ responseid)
      ))
      cf <- coef(m_hr); V <- vcov(m_hr)
      idx_main <- match("treat::blind", names(cf))
      idx_int  <- match("dei_index_z:treat::blind", names(cf))
      if (!is.na(idx_main) && !is.na(idx_int)) {
        for (j in seq_along(dei_pts)) {
          q <- dei_pts[j]
          v <- numeric(length(cf))
          v[idx_main] <- 1; v[idx_int] <- q
          est <- sum(v * cf); se <- sqrt(c(v %*% V %*% v))
          results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <- data.table(
            Stage = "HR Stage", k = k, dei_level = dei_lbl[j],
            estimate = est, ci_low = est - 1.96 * se, ci_high = est + 1.96 * se,
            p_val = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se))
          )
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }

  ## --- Engineer ---
  eng_col  <- paste0("eng_top", k)
  eng_data <- firm_long_dt[role == "Eng" & get(eng_col) > 0]
  ctrl_mean_eng <- eng_data[treat == "nonblind", .wmean(overall_score, get(eng_col))]
  ctrl_sd_eng   <- eng_data[treat == "nonblind", .wsd(overall_score, get(eng_col))]

  if (!is.na(ctrl_sd_eng) && ctrl_sd_eng > 0) {
    eng_data[, overall_score_std := (overall_score - ctrl_mean_eng) / ctrl_sd_eng]

    tryCatch({
      m_eng <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
        feols(overall_score_std ~ i(treat, ref = "nonblind") * dei_index_z + resp_age |
                q_version + resp_gender + resp_race + s2_educ + s2_income +
                resp_python + resp_java,
              data = eng_data, weights = as.formula(paste0('~', eng_col)), vcov = ~ responseid)
      ))
      cf <- coef(m_eng); V <- vcov(m_eng)
      idx_main <- match("treat::blind", names(cf))
      idx_int  <- match("dei_index_z:treat::blind", names(cf))
      if (!is.na(idx_main) && !is.na(idx_int)) {
        for (j in seq_along(dei_pts)) {
          q <- dei_pts[j]
          v <- numeric(length(cf))
          v[idx_main] <- 1; v[idx_int] <- q
          est <- sum(v * cf); se <- sqrt(c(v %*% V %*% v))
          results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <- data.table(
            Stage = "Engineer Stage", k = k, dei_level = dei_lbl[j],
            estimate = est, ci_low = est - 1.96 * se, ci_high = est + 1.96 * se,
            p_val = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se))
          )
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }
}

dt_plot <- rbindlist(results_list)
dt_plot[, Stage := factor(Stage, levels = c("HR Stage", "Engineer Stage"))]
dt_plot[, dei_level := factor(dei_level, levels = dei_lbl)]

p_obj <- ggplot(dt_plot, aes(x = k, y = estimate, color = dei_level, fill = dei_level)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.3) +
  facet_grid(dei_level ~ Stage) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low DEI (-1 SD)"  = "#D9534F",
                                "Mid DEI (0)"      = "gray40",
                                "High DEI (+1 SD)" = "#4C72B0"),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual( values = c("Low DEI (-1 SD)"  = "#D9534F",
                                "Mid DEI (0)"      = "gray40",
                                "High DEI (+1 SD)" = "#4C72B0"),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:18, name = "Number of Candidates Selected (k)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.3, 0.3)) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "TE on hired candidates' actual coding score, by respondent's DEI index level",
    y       = "Effect on Actual Coding Score (SD, relative to nonblind)",
    caption = "Rows: TE evaluated at -1, 0, +1 SD of the within-role z-scored DEI index. Columns: HR vs Engineer. Bands: 95% CI from the linear combination of treat::blind and treat::blind:dei_index_z."
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray30"),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
    plot.caption       = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
  )
print(p_obj)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Underlying per-k estimate table: rows = k, cols = HR/Eng x DEI level.
## Cells: estimate*** (clustered SE) from the linear combination at each
## (k, role, DEI point). add_header_above splits HR vs Engineer.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
dt_plot[, se   := (ci_high - estimate) / 1.96]
dt_plot[, cell := fmt_te_vec(estimate, se)]
tbl <- dcast(dt_plot, k ~ Stage + dei_level, value.var = "cell")
col_order <- c("k",
  "HR Stage_Low DEI (-1 SD)",       "HR Stage_Mid DEI (0)",       "HR Stage_High DEI (+1 SD)",
  "Engineer Stage_Low DEI (-1 SD)", "Engineer Stage_Mid DEI (0)", "Engineer Stage_High DEI (+1 SD)")
col_order <- intersect(col_order, names(tbl))
setcolorder(tbl, col_order)
disp <- c("$k$",
  "Low (-1 SD)", "Mid (0)", "High (+1 SD)",
  "Low (-1 SD)", "Mid (0)", "High (+1 SD)")
setnames(tbl, col_order, disp[seq_along(col_order)])

rm(results_list, dt_plot, tbl, p_obj, dei_pts, dei_lbl, col_order, disp, k,
   hr_col, hr_data, ctrl_mean_hr, ctrl_sd_hr, m_hr,
   eng_col, eng_data, ctrl_mean_eng, ctrl_sd_eng, m_eng,
   cf, V, idx_main, idx_int, est, se, q, v, j)
```

```{r blind_hiring_coding_quality_by_firmtarget, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
   eng_col, eng_data, ctrl_mean_eng, ctrl_sd_eng, m_eng,
```

## Does Blinding's Productivity Effect Differ by Inter-Departmental DEI Misalignment?

```{r blind_hiring_coding_quality_by_misalign, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, out.width="0.95\\textwidth", fig.align="center"}

results_list <- list()
ms_pts <- c(-1, 0, 1)
ms_lbl <- c("Low Misalign (-1 SD)", "Mid Misalign (0)", "High Misalign (+1 SD)")

for (k in 1:18) {

  ## --- HR ---
  hr_col  <- paste0("hr_pass", k)
  hr_data <- firm_long_dt[role == "HR" & get(hr_col) > 0 & !is.na(misalign_z)]
  ctrl_mean_hr <- hr_data[treat == "nonblind", .wmean(overall_score, get(hr_col))]
  ctrl_sd_hr   <- hr_data[treat == "nonblind", .wsd(overall_score, get(hr_col))]

  if (!is.na(ctrl_sd_hr) && ctrl_sd_hr > 0) {
    hr_data[, overall_score_std := (overall_score - ctrl_mean_hr) / ctrl_sd_hr]

    tryCatch({
      m_hr <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
        feols(overall_score_std ~ i(treat, ref = "nonblind") * misalign_z + resp_age |
                q_version + resp_gender + resp_race + s2_educ + s2_income,
              data = hr_data, weights = as.formula(paste0('~', hr_col)), vcov = ~ responseid)
      ))
      cf <- coef(m_hr); V <- vcov(m_hr)
      idx_main <- match("treat::blind", names(cf))
      idx_int  <- match("misalign_z:treat::blind", names(cf))
      if (!is.na(idx_main) && !is.na(idx_int)) {
        for (j in seq_along(ms_pts)) {
          q <- ms_pts[j]
          v <- numeric(length(cf))
          v[idx_main] <- 1; v[idx_int] <- q

  ## --- Engineer ---
```

```{r blind_hiring_coding_quality_by_dei_x_misalign, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, out.width="0.95\\textwidth", fig.align="center"}
for (k in 1:18) {

  if (!is.na(ctrl_sd_hr) && ctrl_sd_hr > 0) {
    hr_data[, overall_score_std := (overall_score - ctrl_mean_hr) / ctrl_sd_hr]

    tryCatch({
      m_hr <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
        feols(overall_score_std ~ i(treat, ref = "nonblind") * dei_index_z * misalign_z + resp_age |
                q_version + resp_gender + resp_race + s2_educ + s2_income,

      cf <- coef(m_hr); V <- vcov(m_hr)

      idx_ms   <- match("misalign_z:treat::blind",             names(cf))
      idx_dms  <- match("dei_index_z:misalign_z:treat::blind", names(cf))
      if (!is.na(idx_main)) {
        for (jd in seq_along(dei_pts)) {
          for (jm in seq_along(ms_pts)) {
            d <- dei_pts[jd]; mm <- ms_pts[jm]
            v <- numeric(length(cf))

            if (!is.na(idx_ms))  v[idx_ms]  <- mm
            if (!is.na(idx_dms)) v[idx_dms] <- d * mm

            results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <- data.table(
              Stage = "HR Stage", k = k,

            )
          }

  }

  ## --- Engineer ---
  eng_col  <- paste0("eng_top", k)

                           !is.na(dei_index_z) & !is.na(misalign_z)]
  ctrl_mean_eng <- eng_data[treat == "nonblind", .wmean(overall_score, get(eng_col))]
  ctrl_sd_eng   <- eng_data[treat == "nonblind", .wsd(overall_score, get(eng_col))]

  if (!is.na(ctrl_sd_eng) && ctrl_sd_eng > 0) {
    eng_data[, overall_score_std := (overall_score - ctrl_mean_eng) / ctrl_sd_eng]

    tryCatch({
      m_eng <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
        feols(overall_score_std ~ i(treat, ref = "nonblind") * dei_index_z * misalign_z + resp_age |
                q_version + resp_gender + resp_race + s2_educ + s2_income +
                resp_python + resp_java,
              data = eng_data, weights = as.formula(paste0('~', eng_col)), vcov = ~ responseid)
      ))
      cf <- coef(m_eng); V <- vcov(m_eng)
      idx_main <- match("treat::blind",                        names(cf))
      idx_dei  <- match("dei_index_z:treat::blind",            names(cf))
      idx_ms   <- match("misalign_z:treat::blind",             names(cf))
      idx_dms  <- match("dei_index_z:misalign_z:treat::blind", names(cf))
      if (!is.na(idx_main)) {
        for (jd in seq_along(dei_pts)) {
          for (jm in seq_along(ms_pts)) {
            d <- dei_pts[jd]; mm <- ms_pts[jm]
            v <- numeric(length(cf))
            v[idx_main] <- 1
            if (!is.na(idx_dei)) v[idx_dei] <- d
            if (!is.na(idx_ms))  v[idx_ms]  <- mm
            if (!is.na(idx_dms)) v[idx_dms] <- d * mm
            est <- sum(v * cf); se <- sqrt(c(v %*% V %*% v))
            results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <- data.table(
              Stage = "Engineer Stage", k = k,
              dei_level = dei_lbl[jd], ms_level = ms_lbl[jm],
              estimate = est, ci_low = est - 1.96 * se, ci_high = est + 1.96 * se
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }
}

Bands: 95% CI from v' Sigma v with v selecting (treat::blind, treat::blind:dei_z, treat::blind:misalign_z, treat::blind:dei_z:misalign_z); coefs dropped for collinearity are treated as constrained to zero. Y-cap +/-0.4 SD."

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Underlying per-k estimate table for the triple interaction.
## Rows = k. Columns: 18 cells per row (HR x 3 misalign x 3 DEI, then

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
dt_plot[, se   := (ci_high - estimate) / 1.96]

   eng_col, eng_data, ctrl_mean_eng, ctrl_sd_eng, m_eng,
   cf, V, idx_main, idx_dei, idx_ms, idx_dms,
   est, se, d, mm, v, jd, jm)
```

\clearpage
# Out-of-Sample Reweighting to the 69-Student Applicant Pool

The experiment randomizes demographic labels onto fixed resume content, so assigned demographics are \emph{orthogonal to true productivity by construction} --- demographic bias can only reshuffle candidates \emph{within} a productivity level, never systematically select less-productive people. The measured null effect on productivity is therefore largely \emph{mechanical}. This section asks whether that null would survive a realistic applicant pool: we take the measured non-blind demographic biases and apply them to the true 69-student pool (real demographics, real lab productivity), simulating blind vs.\ non-blind selection at every hiring cutoff $K = 1, \dots, 69$. Behavior is held fixed (the composition channel); this is a \emph{calibration, not an estimate}. The complementary statistical-discrimination channel --- the only route by which blinding could \emph{hurt} efficiency --- is not identified by this design and is left aside.

```{r oos_compute, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
set.seed(20260703)
local({
  sr_o <- fread(file.path(data_root,"3output_data/Main/student_data/student_matching/student_resume.csv"))
  a69_o<- fread(file.path(data_root,"3output_data/Main/student_data/main_all69_student_sys.csv"))
  sr_o[,resume_index:=suppressWarnings(as.integer(resume_index))]
  sr_o[,os_key:=round(overall_score,3)]; a69_o[,os_key:=round(overall_score,3)]
  sr_o<-merge(sr_o, unique(a69_o,by="os_key")[,.(os_key,max_firm_signal_tier)], by="os_key", all.x=TRUE)
  sr_o[,`:=`(tier_top=as.integer(max_firm_signal_tier=="Top"), tier_ord=as.integer(max_firm_signal_tier%in%c("Ordinary","Growth")))]
  sr_o[is.na(tier_top),tier_top:=0L]; sr_o[is.na(tier_ord),tier_ord:=0L]
  sr_o[,Yo:=overall_score]; sr_o[,rg:=gsub(" ","_",demo_group)]
  for(vv in c("test_case","gpa","num_exp","num_awards")) sr_o[,paste0(vv,"_zo"):=as.numeric(scale(get(vv)))]
  grpo<-c("White_Male","White_Female","Asian_Male","Asian_Female","Hispanic_Male","Hispanic_Female")
  sigo<-list(Eng=c("test_case_zo","gpa_zo","num_exp_zo","num_awards_zo","tier_top","tier_ord"),
             HR =c("gpa_zo","num_exp_zo","num_awards_zo","tier_top","tier_ord"))
  primo<-list()
  for(role_ in c("Eng","HR")){
    bl<-firm_long_dt[treat=="blind"&role==role_,.(bscore=mean(sc_overall_z,na.rm=TRUE)),by=resume_index]
    bl[,resume_index:=suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(resume_index)))]
    fitdt<-merge(sr_o[!is.na(resume_index)],bl,by="resume_index")
    mm0<-lm(as.formula(paste("bscore ~",paste(sigo[[role_]],collapse="+"))),fitdt)
    sr_o[[paste0("shat_",role_)]]<-predict(mm0,sr_o)
    sr_o[[paste0("u_",role_)]]<-sr_o$Yo - predict(lm(as.formula(paste0("Yo ~ shat_",role_)),sr_o),sr_o)
    d<-firm_long_dt[treat=="nonblind"&role==role_]
    feg<-feols(sc_overall_z~i(race_gender,ref="White_Male")|resume_index,d,vcov=~responseid)
    cf<-coef(feg); b<-setNames(rep(0,6),grpo); for(g in grpo){nm<-paste0("race_gender::",g); if(nm%in%names(cf)) b[g]<-cf[nm]}
    pg<-prop.table(table(factor(sr_o$rg,levels=grpo))); b<-b-sum(pg*b)
    d[,bhat:=b[as.character(race_gender)]]
    tau<-tryCatch(as.numeric(attr(lme4::VarCorr(lme4::lmer(sc_overall_z~bhat+factor(resume_index)+(1+bhat|responseid),d))$responseid,"stddev")["bhat"]),error=function(e) 0)
    se<-sd(resid(feols(sc_overall_z~1|resume_index+responseid,firm_long_dt[treat=="blind"&role==role_])))
    primo[[role_]]<-list(b=b,tau=tau,se=se,n_eval=uniqueN(firm_long_dt[role==role_]$responseid))
  }
  SDYo<-sd(sr_o$Yo); no<-nrow(sr_o); rgv<-sr_o$rg; Yv<-sr_o$Yo; ngo<-table(factor(rgv,levels=grpo)); Kg<-c(1:20,seq(25,65,5),69)
  simc<-function(role_,M=300){
    shat<-sr_o[[paste0("shat_",role_)]]; b<-primo[[role_]]$b; tau<-primo[[role_]]$tau; se<-primo[[role_]]$se; bh<-b[rgv]
    cS<-matrix(0,69,6); cSS<-matrix(0,69,6); teS<-numeric(69); teSS<-numeric(69); ynS<-numeric(69); ynQ<-numeric(69); ynN<-numeric(69)
    for(m in 1:M){slope<-rnorm(1,1,tau); eps<-rnorm(no,0,se); ob<-order(-(shat+eps)); on<-order(-(shat+slope*bh+eps))
      gb<-rgv[ob]; gn<-rgv[on]; yb<-cumsum(Yv[ob])/(1:no); yn<-cumsum(Yv[on])/(1:no)
      for(gi in 1:6){eff<-(cumsum(gb==grpo[gi])/as.numeric(ngo[gi])-cumsum(gn==grpo[gi])/as.numeric(ngo[gi]))[1:69]; cS[,gi]<-cS[,gi]+eff; cSS[,gi]<-cSS[,gi]+eff^2}
      dte<-(yb-yn)[1:69]; teS<-teS+dte; teSS<-teSS+dte^2
      for(K in 1:69){ynS[K]<-ynS[K]+sum(Yv[on[1:K]]); ynQ[K]<-ynQ[K]+sum(Yv[on[1:K]]^2); ynN[K]<-ynN[K]+K}}
    ne<-primo[[role_]]$n_eval; st<-ifelse(role_=="Eng","Engineer Stage","HR Stage")
    comp<-rbindlist(lapply(1:6,function(gi){mn<-cS[,gi]/M; sdd<-sqrt(pmax(0,cSS[,gi]/M-mn^2)); s_<-sdd/sqrt(ne)
      data.table(demo=gsub("_"," ",grpo[gi]),k=1:69,estimate=mn,ci_low=mn-1.96*s_,ci_high=mn+1.96*s_,p=2*pnorm(-abs(mn/s_)),Stage=st)}))[k%in%Kg]
    sdK<-sqrt(pmax(1e-9,ynQ/ynN-(ynS/ynN)^2)); tm<-teS/M; tsd<-sqrt(pmax(0,teSS/M-tm^2)); ts<-tsd/sqrt(ne)
    prod<-data.table(k=1:69,estimate=tm/sdK,ci_low=(tm-1.96*ts)/sdK,ci_high=(tm+1.96*ts)/sdK,p=2*pnorm(-abs(tm/ts)),Stage=st)[k%in%Kg]
    list(comp=comp,prod=prod)}
  Eo<-simc("Eng"); Ho<-simc("HR"); compo<-rbind(Eo$comp,Ho$comp); prodo<-rbind(Eo$prod,Ho$prod)
  star<-function(p) fcase(p<0.01,"***",p<0.05,"**",p<0.10,"*",default="")
  compo[,`:=`(Stage=factor(Stage,c("HR Stage","Engineer Stage")),demo=factor(demo,gsub("_"," ",grpo)),sig=star(p),star_y=ifelse(estimate>=0,ci_high+0.01,ci_low-0.01))]
  prodo[,`:=`(Stage=factor(Stage,c("HR Stage","Engineer Stage")),sig=star(p))]
  sens_sim<-function(role_,a,K,M=200){shat<-sr_o[[paste0("shat_",role_)]]; b<-primo[[role_]]$b; tau<-primo[[role_]]$tau; se<-primo[[role_]]$se
    u<-sr_o[[paste0("u_",role_)]]; uu<-as.numeric(scale(u)); pg<-prop.table(table(factor(rgv,levels=grpo))); gord<-names(sort(b)); ngg<-pmax(1,round(as.numeric(pg[gord])*no))
    te<-numeric(M); rc<-numeric(M)
    for(m in 1:M){key<--a*uu+sqrt(max(0,1-a^2))*rnorm(no); oc<-order(key); grp<-character(no); ix<-1
      for(gi in seq_along(gord)){cnt<-if(gi==length(gord))(no-ix+1) else ngg[gi]; grp[oc[ix:(ix+cnt-1)]]<-gord[gi]; ix<-ix+cnt}
      bh<-b[grp]; rc[m]<-cor(bh,u); slope<-rnorm(1,1,tau); eps<-rnorm(no,0,se)
      te[m]<-mean(Yv[order(-(shat+eps))[1:K]])-mean(Yv[order(-(shat+slope*bh+eps))[1:K]])}
    c(be=mean(te)/SDYo, rc=mean(rc))}
  senso<-rbindlist(lapply(c("Eng","HR"),function(r) rbindlist(lapply(c(5,10),function(K) rbindlist(lapply(seq(-0.6,0.6,0.2),function(a){o<-sens_sim(r,a,K); data.table(Stage=ifelse(r=="Eng","Engineer Stage","HR Stage"),K=K,realcorr=o["rc"],be=o["be"])}))))))
  figComp_oos <<- ggplot(compo,aes(k,estimate,color=Stage))+geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype="dashed",color="gray50",linewidth=0.6)+
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=ci_low,ymax=ci_high),linewidth=0.5,size=0.3,fatten=2.5)+geom_text(aes(y=star_y,label=sig),size=2.6,color="black",show.legend=FALSE)+
    facet_grid(demo~Stage)+scale_color_manual(values=c("HR Stage"="#C44E52","Engineer Stage"="#4C72B0"))+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1,10,20,30,40,50,60,69),name="Number Hired (K, of 69 applicants)")+scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0.05,0.20)))+
    labs(title="Blinding Effect on Selection Probability by Group (Out-of-Sample 69-Pool)",subtitle="Blinding effect = P(selected | blind) - P(selected | non-blind). Positive = more likely under blinding.",y="Blinding Effect on Selection Probability",color="Evaluator Role",caption="Real 69-student demographics; simulation bands (evaluator-clustered). * p<0.10, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01.")+
    theme_bw()+theme(legend.position="bottom",plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12),plot.subtitle=element_text(size=9,color="gray30"),strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=9),strip.text.y=element_text(angle=0),panel.grid.minor.x=element_blank(),plot.caption=element_text(size=8,hjust=0))
  figProd_oos <<- ggplot(prodo,aes(k,estimate,color=Stage))+geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype="dashed",color="gray50",linewidth=0.8)+
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=ci_low,ymax=ci_high),linewidth=0.7,size=0.5,fatten=3)+geom_text(aes(y=ci_high,label=sig),vjust=-0.5,size=4,color="black",show.legend=FALSE)+
    facet_wrap(~Stage,ncol=2)+scale_color_manual(values=c("HR Stage"="#C44E52","Engineer Stage"="#4C72B0"))+scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1,10,20,30,40,50,60,69),name="Number Hired (K, of 69 applicants)")+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.3,0.3))+
    labs(title="Treatment Effect on Productivity of Hired (Out-of-Sample 69-Pool)",subtitle="Effect of blinding on true productivity of the hired cohort, standardized to non-blind at each k",y="Effect on Productivity (SD, rel. to nonblind)",caption="Positive = blinding selects higher-productivity candidates. Fixed-behavior composition channel.")+
    theme_bw()+theme(legend.position="none",plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12),plot.subtitle=element_text(size=9,color="gray30"),strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=11),panel.grid.minor.x=element_blank(),plot.caption=element_text(size=8,hjust=0))
  figSens_oos <<- ggplot(senso,aes(realcorr,be,color=factor(K)))+geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype=2,color="gray60")+geom_line()+geom_point()+facet_wrap(~Stage)+
    labs(x="Assumed corr(group bias, unobserved productivity u)",y="Effect of blinding on hire productivity (SD)",color="Top-K",title="Sensitivity: productivity effect vs. an assumed identity-productivity correlation",subtitle="corr = 0 recovers the measured null; even at a strong correlation the effect stays small")+theme_minimal(base_size=10)
})
```

## Compositional Change of the Hired Cohort

Blinding removes the non-blind premia/penalties, so it mechanically reshuffles \emph{who} is hired. Effects concentrate deeper in the distribution (higher $K$), where lower-ranked groups finally enter the hired set, and vanish as $K \to 69$ (hiring everyone leaves no selection).

```{r oos_comp_fig, echo=FALSE, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=8.5, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}
print(figComp_oos)
```

## Treatment Effect on Productivity

Despite the compositional reshuffle, the effect on the true productivity of the hired cohort is \textbf{null across the entire hiring margin}, in both stages. Composition moves; productivity does not --- the biases are modest and demographic identity carries little productivity information beyond the visible signals.

```{r oos_prod_fig, echo=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.2, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}
print(figProd_oos)
```

## How Large Would the Identity--Productivity Link Have to Be?

We sweep the correlation between the group bias a candidate attracts and the productivity left \emph{unobserved} by the score. At correlation zero the measured null is recovered; even at a strong correlation the productivity effect stays within roughly $\pm 0.02$ SD. The composition channel is bounded by the (modest) biases and by how little of productivity is unobserved --- not by the demographic mix, so reweighting to a different pool cannot rescue a large effect. Any larger effect would have to come from the statistical-discrimination channel, which this design cannot identify.

```{r oos_sens_fig, echo=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}
print(figSens_oos)
```

\textbf{Caveats.} Calibration, not estimation; behavior held fixed (statistical-discrimination channel omitted); the content-score map is extrapolated from the 18 shown resumes; the pool is Berkeley-CS (79\% Asian, with rare Hispanic-female / White-female cells, so those group panels are noisy), not the US market.
